related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket

observation.source_interface: MNCS Control exact-session continuation contract and MNCS Environment live readback

outcome.implementation_change: Control can select an exact session through its local continuation adapter, derive the campaign only from a canonical same-principal session, and preserve project, checkout, lifecycle, and claim-conflict checks. The direct continuation operation now accepts the same exact session selector.
outcome.analysis_limit: The targeted Control suites passed, but the subsequent call through the currently connected Environment client still rejected the direct session_id argument and returned an ambiguous campaign inventory for a context request. The live readback does not establish the cause or the behavior after client refresh.

improvement_relation.basis: An exact-session continuation path was implemented and its project, ownership, and foreign-session protections passed targeted regression suites. The subsequent live client still exposed the previous unsupported-argument and ambiguous-campaign behavior, so this change is verified in Control but its effect on that client remains unconfirmed.
not_measured: whether the connected client has refreshed the merged Control source
whether exact session selection now succeeds through a refreshed client
recurrence of the observed selection pressure across independent sessions
agent outcome changes after the client and Control path are both aligned
the reason the active client rejects the new selector
long-term recurrence or elimination of the selection pressure
